notes.rf_erp_beta: rf 4.94% (10y UST, 29-30.10.2026 market row of the 1.11 draft); ERP 4.2% (implied, same source); beta 1.12 = 2-year weekly vs SPY (given by the main loop); ke0 = 9.64%, fading to 9.14% (beta 1.0) over 10 years; terminal growth = rf (engine convention)
notes.shares_m: 7,446 diluted weighted Q1 FY27 (release 2026-10-28). Buybacks ($4.4B/qtr) roughly offset SBC dilution (shares -0.3% y/y); held flat, which is slightly conservative
notes.fy27_margin: FY27 GAAP operating margin ~46.5% (Q1 49.8%; Q2 guide: rev 96.55, COGS 32.8, opex 18.55 -> 46.8%, 'down slightly y/y'; H2 ~45.5%/44.5% as D&A rises). Cross-check: AV consensus FY27 EPS 20.02 -> NI 149B -> EBIT ~184B = 46.5%
notes.net_cash_m: End FY27 (June 2027), $M: cash+ST investments ~58,000 (64,509 at 30.9.2026 less ~6B net of FCF after dividends 6.8B/qtr and buybacks 4.4B/qtr over Q2-Q4) minus debt 35,000 (35,481 at 30.9.2026, assumed refinanced) minus finance-lease liabilities ~88,000 (70,973 at 30.9.2026 + ~7.4B new finance leases/qtr per Hood less ~1B principal/qtr) = -65,000; minus 36,000 = 10% of the $364.6B leases not yet commenced (10-Q Note, FY27-FY34, terms 1-20 years) treated as debt-like at a 90% HAIRCUT: 90% is excluded because those leases' cost enters the margin path (operating-lease rent in COGS) or the capex path (finance leases counted as capex at commencement) once they start, so counting them as debt too would double count; the 10% is a deliberate stranded-capacity reserve for the leases 'subject to conditions'. Result -101,000 (= -$13.6/share). Equity investments (37.8B incl. the OpenAI stake) are NOT added: non-spendable, carrying value uncertain
notes.capex_path: Capex all-in (cash PP&E + finance leases at commencement), $B: FY27 190 (Q1 45.2 all-in / 39.4 cash; Hood: H2 accelerates on CPUs, memory, GPUs and the third-party capacity shifted to H2; April 2026 FY27 guide 'roughly $190B incl ~$25B component pricing'; press reports $170-175B cash). Base: FY28 215, FY29 230, FY30-33 235 (plateau, 46%->32% of revenue). Bear: 200, 160, 140, 130, 130, 130 (cut with a lag). Bull: 215, 240, 255, 260, 260, 260
notes.da_path: D&A $B from the capex cohorts (servers/network 2-6 years ~75% of capex; buildings 5-15 years, 25-year change NOT found in the 10-Q): FY27 54 (Q1 11.7, 12.7% of revenue, +44% y/y). Base: FY28 80, FY29 105, FY30 128, FY31 142, FY32 150, FY33 155 (17-22% of revenue). Bear: 80, 100, 110, 110, 105, 100. Bull: 80, 108, 135, 152, 162, 168
notes.margin_path: m = EBITDA margin minus D&A share. Base EBITDA margin 61->64.5% (opex +9% vs revenue +19% gives leverage; COGS ex-D&A rises with Azure mix, energy and third-party GPU leases) less D&A 17->22% -> op margin 44% FY28 falling to 41% FY30 and recovering to 43% FY33. This is BELOW consensus (FY28 EPS 24.14 implies ~47%): my judgement is that consensus under-weights the D&A wave. Bear: EBITDA 57->55.5% (price pressure, underused fleet, fixed lease cost) -> 39% to 32% and back to 37.5%. Bull: EBITDA 62->67% (Copilot ARPU, usage billing, Maia efficiency) -> 45.5-48%
notes.conv: FCF/NOPAT per year from the explicit build: FCF = NOPAT + D&A - capex (all-in) + working capital (+3B/yr base, deferred revenue growth; 0 bear; +4B bull). SBC is NOT added back (FCF after SBC, 3.4% of revenue). Base FY28: 467*0.44*0.81=166 + 80 - 215 + 3 = 34 -> 0.21; FY29 59/181 = 0.33; FY30 92/196 = 0.47; FY31 124/214 = 0.58; FY32 155/237 = 0.65; FY33 183/260 = 0.70
notes.growth: Base FY28 +18%: Azure ~+35% (Dec-q guide 49-50% cc; capacity still constrained; H2 third-party capacity; OpenAI's $250B Azure commitment; ~30% of $677B RPO = $203B in 12 months, +29% y/y), M365 commercial cloud ~+15% (guide 19% cc, accelerating through FY27), Devices and Consumer flat (Windows OEM -27%, Xbox -2%). Then 14, 11, 9, 8, 7 (fade to the size-class and the RPO duration 2.3 years). Consensus FY28 475B (+20%). Bear: 12, 7, 5, 4, 4, 4 (OpenAI demand/credit event, Azure +22% then +10%, seat compression, PC decline). Bull: 22, 18, 15, 12, 10, 9 (Azure >40% in FY28, agents monetized, bookings record)
notes.pe: Exit forward P/E at June 2032 on FY33 operating EPS. Gordon at mature ke 9.14%, g = rf 4.94%, payout 1-g/ROIC(18%) = 73% -> 17.4x; with growth still 7% in FY33 fading over 9 years a justified multiple is ~21-22x -> base 22. Bear 16 (growth 4%, lower ROIC). Bull 26 (growth 9% fading, MSFT 10-year range 25-35x forward)
notes.charges_bear: After-tax $M: index 0 (FY28) 10,000 = OpenAI receivable ($7.2B at 30.9.2026) and part of the equity-method carrying value written down; index 1 (FY29) 29,000 = 10% of the $364.6B not-yet-commenced leases stranded (36B pre-tax, 19% tax); index 2 (FY30) 15,000 = about half of the IRS NOPA $28.9B (2004-2013 transfer pricing; company disputes; not tax-deductible). Base and bull: none (IRS treated as reserved per the 10-Q)
notes.roic_terminal: 0.18: FY33 NOPAT ~260B on invested capital ~1,100B (net P&E ~1,000B after the capex wave) = 24% on the total; incremental AI-infrastructure returns lower; 18% used
notes.what_is_not_modelled: Buybacks/dividends (cash accumulates at cash_yield instead); the OpenAI stake's market value (27% of a ~$500B valuation in press, ~$135B, is NOT added: no primary source, no liquidity, HLBV carrying value far lower); FX; the 25-year useful-life change (not in the 10-Q; if adopted, D&A falls and the margin path rises ~1 point)
